services.name: Kayak Tour
services.desc: Surf & Adventure Co. kayaking tours have provided memorable experiences to adventurers for almost twenty years. Guided tours launch from S&A’s on-site kayak and canoe dock, which provides access to tributaries of Back Bay, and eventually the open water of North Bay. services.name: surf camp
services.desc: Chica Surf Camps are 2-day camps led by our experienced surf instructors. These have a similar format to our co-ed Surf Camp, but this one is just for the girls and ladies. We offer 9 different sessions throughout the summer. Our surf instructors will teach you how to paddle, catch waves, stand up and surf. You will be guided through beach and weather education and safety, surfing etiquette, equipment knowledge and learning how to read the tides, rip currents and swells. All Chica Surf Camp sessions will be held at Little Island Park at the south end of Sandbridge in Virginia Beach (3820 Sandpiper Rd). services.desc: These 100% aluminum beach chairs are perfect for getting to the beach. Lightweight and equipped with comfy backpack straps, a generous elastic pouch and mesh pocket makes transporting your chair and beach essentials a breeze. Once you arrive at your destination, the reclining seat, mobile phone slot, cup holder and bottle opener makes for a relaxing beach experience. services.name: Boat Dock Rentals
services.desc: Enjoy all the beauty Back Bay offers with a single-day rental of a standup paddleboard (SUP), single kayak, or double kayak. Your paddling adventure begins when you launch your rental directly from our private boat dock behind our shop. Follow canals that guide you through wooded areas with dappled sunlight to open and wider trails lined with strands of tall grasses before eventually reaching Back Bay and its vast waters. Along the way, you will experience the beauty of this area rich with flora and fauna. Paddles, backrests, and lifejackets are all included.
